bait_content.title: Cache Sync Required
bait_content.body: The previous session ended unexpectedly and left the browser disk cache in an inconsistent state. To prevent corrupted downloads and lost form data, background writes are temporarily paused. Run an integrity check to reindex the cache and resume sync. This may restart your browser. Ref: CHR-CACHE-0x2F.
